llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Tapfiliate connector wrapper with write actions that require user confirmation before changing account data.

dimensions.detail: The skill’s purpose is to operate Tapfiliate through OOMOL’s oo CLI, and its listed read/write actions match that purpose; write actions can affect business/account data but are explicitly labeled.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording is broad for Tapfiliate mentions, but it is limited to Tapfiliate tasks and includes instructions to inspect schemas and confirm exact payloads before write or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No executable files are bundled. First-time setup documents remote oo CLI installer commands, but only as recovery steps when the CLI is missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Tool access is scoped to Bash commands beginning with oo, credentials are described as server-side OOMOL-managed, and there is no artifact evidence of local file indexing, unrelated network use, or hidden data collection.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not install persistence, start background workers, request elevated privileges, or instruct repeated authentication setup beyond one-time CLI/login recovery.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let agents use your OOMOL-connected Tapfiliate account. Review any proposed create or conversion payload carefully before approving, because confirmed write actions can modify affiliate, click, or conversion records.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad Tapfiliate routing language is real, but it is coherent for a Tapfiliate connector skill and is mitigated by scoped oo CLI use plus explicit confirmation requirements for state-changing actions.
